outcome_note: Direct refusal documented by the Valukas examiner's 2009 Buffett interview, reported March 11, 2010; March 28 was the approach, not a completed rejection that day. Do not infer the March 29 Japan discovery was known on March 28. This is a direction/discipline test, not a return forecast. Nonholding evidence is scoped to the parent discretionary portfolio and the tested window; quarterly 13Fs cannot prove absence of every intraperiod trade, nonreportable instrument, subsidiary client holding or personal investment.
pack_quality_notes: March 28 close unavailable; March 27 close verified in contemporary Citi report. Private-call details excluded from public pack; exact refusal day not established. Later examiner account, not invented FCIC verbatim quotation. Silent controls do not have three authentic stated reasons; the three slots distinguish action, ownership verification and grading boundary rather than fabricate quotes. Deputy keys use user-requested decider='deputy'; meta retains the allowed named/unknown identity. PASS label is nonpurchase/refusal evidence, not proof a presented bull thesis was publicly evaluated.
